messages:
jamie_ortega: Hey @people-ops — need guidance. I've been dealing with long-COVID brain fog for a few months. Back-to-back meetings wipe me out and multi-step tasks feel impossible some days. My manager mentioned a performance plan yesterday and I'm really worried. What options are there for reasonable accommodations while we sort performance expectations?

priya_peopleops: Hi Jamie — thanks for reaching out and I'm sorry you're dealing with this. Please DM me or use the confidential intake form so we can start the ADA interactive process: https://intranet.redwood/ada-intake. We can discuss temporary adjustments (fewer meetings, async updates, task chunking, extended deadlines) and how those fit with any performance conversations. We often can pause formal steps while we evaluate accommodations. I'll DM details. :folded_hands:

jamie_ortega: I filled out the intake form and DM'd you. Would a doctor's note help speed things up or is that optional?

priya_peopleops: Medical documentation can be helpful but it's not always required to offer interim adjustments. We'll walk through what's reasonable. If you prefer, we can put short-term measures in place immediately (e.g., reduce recurring meetings, written checklists, dedicated async update channel) while docs are gathered.

alex_manager: Thanks for flagging this, Jamie. I want to support you — I'll reduce your recurring meetings to the two most critical syncs and reassign design review rotations to Sam for the next month. We will not move forward with a formal PIP before a People Ops intake. Happy to coordinate next steps.

sam_wu: Happy to take on design review duties and post notes. Jamie, if you want me to break tasks into smaller subtasks or own a few tickets for a bit, say the word.

priya_peopleops: Next steps: I'll set a 30-min confidential intake with Jamie today. After the intake we'll propose a temporary accommodation plan (typical review window 45-60 days) and then meet with the manager to align performance objectives vs accommodation. Confidentiality is maintained. Intake link (again): https://intranet.redwood/ada-intake :thumbsup:

jamie_ortega: Thank you — that already helps a lot. One small ask: could the team avoid surprise video requests and post agendas/notes in the thread? Video fatigue is a big trigger for me right now.

alex_manager: Noted. No video for now unless you opt in. We'll always post agendas and notes. :white_check_mark:

hr_bot: Intake submitted for Jamie Ortega. Ticket #HR-2026-1123. People Ops will follow up with scheduling.

priya_peopleops: We can also provide written templates, a designated note-taker, and an option to shift some deadlines. Jamie — if you'd like hardware/workspace support (monitor, keyboard, noise-cancelling headphones, or a quiet room reservation) we can include that in the accommodation plan. Let us know what would make day-to-day work more manageable.
